name: Scrapling
headline: Scrapling: Python Web Scraping with Anti-Bot Bypass
short_description: Scrapling is a Python web scraping library built for production environments with anti-bot detection, automatic CAPTCHA bypass, and JavaScript rendering without headless browsers. It handles Cloudflare protection, proxy rotation, and rate limiting automatically, using 70% less memory than Selenium. Data engineers use scrapling for large-scale scraping pipelines, competitive intelligence, and automated content extraction where traditional scrapers like BeautifulSoup or Scrapy get blocked.
author: D4Vinci

sections.overview:
Using scrapling to scrape Cloudflare-protected e-commerce sites for price monitoring
Building scrapling pipelines for large-scale product data extraction with automatic proxy rotation
Deploying async scrapling scripts to extract JavaScript-rendered content without Selenium
Implementing scrapling for real estate listing aggregation across anti-bot protected sites
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`claude install D4Vinci/Scrapling`
`git clone https://github.com/D4Vinci/Scrapling`
sections.usage:
```
Use scrapling to extract product pricing data from [ECOMMERCE_SITE] for [PRODUCT_CATEGORY]. Set up a scraper that runs daily at [TIME] and saves the results to a CSV file in [CLOUD_STORAGE_PATH]. Include error handling for CAPTCHAs and rate limiting. Use proxy rotation to avoid IP blocking.
```
Copy

```
Scraper setup complete for extracting product pricing data from Amazon for 'Smart Home Devices'. The scraper will run daily at 2:00 AM and save results to 'gs://my-bucket/scraping-results/'. It includes automatic CAPTCHA solving and proxy rotation. Initial test run successfully collected 1,243 product listings with prices, descriptions, and availability. Memory usage was 68% lower than with Selenium. The scraper will automatically retry failed requests up to 3 times before marking them as failed. Alerts will be sent to [EMAIL] if the failure rate exceeds 10% in a single run.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent

headline_vi: Scrapling: Web Scraping bằng Python với khả năng Vượt Anti-Bot
short_description_vi: Scrapling là một thư viện web scraping bằng Python được thiết kế cho môi trường production, tích hợp khả năng phát hiện anti-bot, tự động vượt CAPTCHA và render JavaScript mà không cần headless browser. Thư viện này tự động xử lý cơ chế bảo vệ của Cloudflare, proxy rotation và rate limiting, đồng thời tiết kiệm bộ nhớ đến 70% so với Selenium. Các data engineer sử dụng Scrapling cho các pipeline scraping quy mô lớn, thu thập thông tin cạnh tranh và trích xuất nội dung tự động trong những trường hợp mà các công cụ scraper truyền thống như BeautifulSoup hay Scrapy bị chặn.
